//: Cursor's project hook wiring. The Claude Code equivalent is .claude/settings.json; both point at the SAME scripts in .claude/hooks/, which are host-agnostic since _lib.mjs normalises the payload and output shapes. Two copies of a guard, one per editor, is how one of them silently stops being enforced.
//scripts-location: The scripts still live under .claude/hooks/ even though they are no longer Claude-only. Renaming that folder means touching settings.json, build-plugin.mjs, every doc and the generated plugin tree - and then moving them a second time when the core/ + adapters/ split happens. It is deliberately left for that change.
//matchers: Deliberately absent on preToolUse. A matcher that does not match is a guard that silently never fires, and the scripts already exit 0 in microseconds when the payload is not theirs. Fail-safe beats fail-silent for a security guard.

beforeShellExecution.//: Cursor's purpose-built shell hook. Better than routing shell through preToolUse: it fires only for commands, carries the command at the top level, and can answer 'ask' as well as 'deny'.

beforeMCPExecution.//: The database and the GitHub account are reachable through MCP, and until now nothing in this repo had an opinion about that. Policy lives in .cursor/mcp-policy.json.
